title: CD4+ T Cell Isolation and Stimulation
author: Dorota Kmiec
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.r7ad9ie
materials: RosetteSep™ Human CD4+ T Cell Enrichment Cocktail (Stemcell)
Bring all reagents and the centrifuge (Eppendorf 5810R) to a room temperature.

Optional: determine isolated cell purity by staining for CD4 and CD11c surface receptors and flow cytometric analysis. Suggested antibodies: anti-CD4-PerCP (cat# 550631, BD Biosciences) and anti-CD11c-FITC (cat#ab22540, abcam). CD4+ T cells are CD4+ and CD11c - .

steps.title: Enrich CD4+ T cells
steps.instruction: Dilute the buffy coat 1:4 with DPBS (Gibco); add 50 µl RosetteSep™ Human CD4+ T Cell Enrichment Cocktail (Stemcell) per 1 ml of diluted buffy coat; incubate 20 min at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µl RosetteSep™ per 1 ml diluted buffy coat.

steps.title: Prepare density gradient
steps.instruction: Add 20 ml Biocoll separating solution (Biochrom, cat# L6115) to a 50 ml plastic tube; slowly layer 20 ml diluted buffy coat over the Biocoll without mixing; centrifuge at 1200 RCF for 20 min with the brake switched off.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 ml Biocoll separating solution to a 50 ml tube.
Slowly pipette 20 ml diluted buffy coat over Biocoll without mixing.
Centrifuge at 1200 RCF for 20 min, brake off.

steps.title: Collect CD4+ cell layer
steps.instruction: Transfer the white interface containing CD4+ T cells to a new 50 ml tube; add DPBS up to a total volume of 40 ml and centrifuge at 1400 rpm for 5 min.

substeps.instruction: Transfer white interface to a new 50 ml tube.
Add DPBS to reach 40 ml total volume.

steps.title: Wash cells
steps.instruction: Remove supernatant, resuspend pellet in 40 ml DPBS, centrifuge again at 1400 rpm for 5 min, then remove supernatant and resuspend cell pellet in 10 ml RPMI‑1640 supplemented with 2 mM L‑glutamine, 100 µg/ml streptomycin, 100 U/ml penicillin, and 10 % (v/v) heat‑inactivated FCS (Gibco).

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant and resuspend in 40 ml DPBS.
Remove supernatant and resuspend in 10 ml supplemented RPMI‑1640.

steps.title: Optional infection step
steps.instruction: If cells are to be infected with SIV or HIV, follow steps 16‑17.

steps.title: Adjust cell concentration
steps.instruction: Adjust cell concentration to 2 000 000 cells/ml by adding additional medium.

steps.title: Stimulate cells with PHA/IL‑2
steps.instruction: Add 1 µg/ml PHA (Murex) and 10 ng/ml IL‑2 (Sigma‑Ark) to the cell suspension.

steps.title: Incubate stimulated cells
steps.instruction: Incubate for 3 days at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂; stimulated cells should form large clumps.
